mapper.select: SELECT base.id, base.year, base.semester, base.course_name, base.course_code, base.credits, base.status, base.attendance_rate, CASE WHEN base.attendance_rate < 75 THEN 'F' ELSE IFNULL(base.grade, '미입력') END AS grade, CASE WHEN base.attendance_rate < 75 THEN 0.0 ELSE IFNULL(base.grade_point, 0.0) END AS grade_point FROM ( SELECT e.id AS id, s.academic_year AS year, IF(s.term = 'FIRST', 1, 2) AS semester, c.name AS course_name, c.code AS course_code, c.credits, e.status AS status, e.grade_status AS grade_status, e.letter_grade AS grade, CASE WHEN e.letter_grade = 'A+' THEN 4.5 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'A' THEN 4.0 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'B+' THEN 3.5 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'B' THEN 3.0 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'C+' THEN 2.5 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'C' THEN 2.0 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'D+' THEN 1.5 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN e.letter_grade = 'F' THEN 0.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS grade_point, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.id) = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'EXCUSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id) * 100, 2) END AS attendance_rate FROM enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN semesters s ON l.semester_id = s.id LEFT JOIN attendances a ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN students st ON e.student_id = st.id WHERE st.user_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY e.id, s.academic_year, s.term, c.name, c.code, c.credits, e.status, e.grade_status, e.letter_grade, e.total_score ) base ORDER BY base.year DESC, base.semester DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grades ( enrollment_id, score, letter_grade, midterm_score, final_score, assignment_score, attendance_score, status, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{enrollmentId}, 0.00, 'F', 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 'DRAFT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE grades SET score = #{score}, letter_grade = #{letterGrade}, midterm_score = #{midtermScore}, final_score = #{finalScore}, assignment_score = #{assignmentScore}, attendance_score = #{attendanceScore}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE grades SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE grades SET objection_reason = #{objectionReason}, status = 'OBJECTION', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE grades SET objection_reply = #{objectionReply}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(g.id, 0) AS id, e.id AS enrollment_id, IFNULL(g.score, 0.00) AS score, IFNULL(g.letter_grade, 'F') AS letter_grade, g.updated_at, IFNULL(g.midterm_score, 0.00) AS midterm_score, IFNULL(g.final_score, 0.00) AS final_score, IFNULL(g.assignment_score, 0.00) AS assignment_score, IFNULL(g.attendance_score, 0.00) AS attendance_score, IFNULL(g.status, 'DRAFT') AS status, g.objection_reason, g.objection_reply, u.name AS student_name, u.login_id AS student_login_id FROM enrollments e LEFT JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE e.lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
